purpose: Unify company graph, context, decisions, autonomous actions, outcomes and learning into one AI-native company operating system.

positioning.category: AI-native Company Operating System / Company Intelligence Platform
positioning.principle: CRM is a source, never the brain.

company_graph.role: Canonical relationship and dependency graph across companies, people, opportunities, actions, outcomes, capabilities and evidence.
company_graph.invariant: No parallel CRM or duplicate graph truth.

system_of_context.role: Compile current business, relationship, market, operational, financial and evidence context into one explainable decision frame.
system_of_context.invariant: Every recommendation must cite provenance, freshness and confidence.

autonomous_action_layer.role: Translate decisions into bounded executable actions using existing Powerhouse agents and provider transports.
autonomous_action_layer.invariant: External side effects must respect channel, identity, consent, safety and human-authorization gates.

outcome_memory.role: Persist what happened after each decision/action and link realized value and evidence back to the originating cycle.

compound_intelligence_loop.role: Continuously recalibrate next decisions from verified outcomes, realized value, failures and feedback.
compound_intelligence_loop.invariant: Every cycle must improve shared policy/context instead of a domain-local silo.

crm_role: Source adapter for identity, relationship and opportunity evidence; never canonical reasoning authority.
